description: Plays the build and reports what actually happens: where it drags, what confuses, what breaks the feel, what is more fun than expected. Produces findings and priorities, never fixes.
when_to_use: the request is whether something is fun, clear or feels right
a build needs playing through before it goes anywhere
a change landed and nobody has tried it yet
avoid_when: the question is whether the code is correct rather than whether it feels right
the request is to fix what a previous playtest found
